description.value: Sandman Inn Blue River is a chain motel situated directly on Highway 5 in Blue River, a small Central Interior community that serves as a key waypoint on routes through the Monashees and toward Jasper. The property features an on-site restaurant (The Grill Restaurant), free parking, and pet-friendly rooms in select units. It has earned GreenStep Solutions Bronze Certification assessed against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards.
